narrative.overview: A graphic personal identity built from strong lettering and mineral surfaces. The dark ground is suited to a focused evening read; generous chalk letterforms make the face and name recognizable before the detailed content begins. Copper carries a complete working region rather than decorative points of light.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed identity lettering, open geometric body text.
Planar sections rather than cards and floating surfaces.
Mineral copper used as a content-bearing field.
Portraits treated as authored illustrations, never presented as photography.

rules.name: The Field Rule
rules.body: A large copper region uses copper ink for every content-bearing element, not low-opacity white text.

rules.name: The Voice Rule
rules.body: The name and headings are condensed; explanations and functional controls stay in the open body face. No technical monospace costume.

dos: Do use open rows and planar regions to organize connected content.
Do preserve a 12px minimum for supporting and functional text.
Do make copper a reading surface with dark ink.
donts: Don't introduce glow, decorative glass, generic icon cards or claim-based metrics.
Don't extend the identity-letter size to ordinary prose headings.
Don't imply that the local outline tool sends a message.
